ancestries.name: Catfolk
ancestries.description: Curious and agile feline-folk with keen senses, retractable claws, and an innate grace that makes them natural travelers.

ancestries.name: Ratfolk
ancestries.description: Communal, inquisitive rodent-folk who thrive in tight-knit communities and excel at crafting, trading, and squeezing into small spaces.

ancestries.name: Kobold
ancestries.description: Small, reptilian tunnel-dwellers who revere dragons, love traps, and possess an almost pathological need to serve powerful creatures.

ancestries.name: Lizardfolk
ancestries.description: Scaly, cold-blooded hunters with a pragmatic worldview, powerful jaws, and an instinctive connection to swamps and jungles.

ancestries.name: Orc
ancestries.description: Powerful, tusked warriors with a fierce reputation, deep loyalty to their kin, and an indomitable will to survive.

ancestries.name: Hobgoblin
ancestries.description: Disciplined, militaristic goblinoids who value order, strategy, and martial excellence above all else.
